capabilities: Generate Anki notes from the current file with AI
Generate Anki notes from highlighted text
Review, select and export notes to a chosen Anki deck
Send diagrams and images to the model
Tag exported Anki notes with model, effort and prompt metadata
extras: Desktop only. Notes are sent to the AI provider only when Generate is run; API keys are stored in Obsidian's Keychain per device and do not sync. The plugin only adds notes to Anki, never edits or deletes existing ones.
motivation: The author wanted to use spaced repetition with Anki to retain what he reads and watches, automating card creation from his existing Obsidian vaults without changing how he writes notes.
problem: Obsidian cannot turn notes into Anki cards on its own, and existing connectors require special note formatting.

relations.evidence: AnkiConnect, which exposes Anki's API for Obsidian to call
uses OpenAI or Claude to generate Anki notes from your Obsidian notes
uses OpenAI or Claude to generate Anki notes from your Obsidian notes

summary: Generates Anki flashcard notes from an Obsidian note or selected text using OpenAI or Claude.
